segments.tha-ap537:6.3: Nipacca pādamūlamhi, taṃ ṭhānaṃ patthayiṃ ahaṃ.
segments.tha-ap537:9.3: Esa pattheti taṃ ṭhānaṃ, vicittakathikattanaṃ [vicittakathikattadaṃ (sī. pī.)].
segments.tha-ap537:10.3: Gotamo nāma gottena, satthā loke bhavissati.
segments.tha-ap537:15.3: Sākhena cattā me mātā, nigrodhaṃ saraṇaṃ gatā.
segments.tha-ap537:16.3: Pariccajitvā sapāṇaṃ [saṃpāṇaṃ (sī. pī.)], mamevaṃ ovadī tadā.
segments.tha-ap537:17.3: Nigrodhasmiṃ mataṃ seyyo, yañce sākhamhi jīvitaṃ’.
segments.tha-ap537:18.1: “Tenānusiṭṭhā migayūthapena, ahañca mātā ca tathetare ca [citare ca (syā.), tassovādena (pī.), citare ca tassovādaṃ (ka.)];
segments.tha-ap537:18.3: Āgamma rammaṃ tusitādhivāsaṃ, gatā pavāsaṃ sagharaṃ yatheva.
segments.tha-ap537:27.1: “Svāgataṃ vata me āsi … pe … kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ.
segments.tha-ap537:29.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā kumārakassapo thero imā gāthāyo Abhāsitthāti.

lines: So arahattaṃ patvā attano pubbakammaṃ saritvā somanassajāto pubbacaritāpadānaṃ pakāsento ito satasahassamhītiādimāha.
Tattha yaṃ heṭṭhā vuttanayañca uttānatthañca, taṃ sabbaṃ na vaṇṇayissāma.
Āpannasattā me mātāti mayhaṃ mātā garugabbhā gabbhinī pasutāsannagabbhāti attho.

Vammikasadisaṃ kāyanti sarīraṃ nāma vammikasadisaṃ yathā vammiko ito cito ca chiddāvachiddo gharagoḷikaupacikādīnaṃ āsayo, evameva ayaṃ kāyo navachiddo dhuvassavoti buddhena bhagavatā desitaṃ pakāsitaṃ taṃ sutvā me cittaṃ āsave aggahetvā asesetvā kilesato vimucci, arahatte patiṭṭhāsīti attho.

Aparabhāge tattha tattha bhikkhūnaṃ vicittadhammakathikabhāvaṃ sutvā satthā “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ cittakathikānaṃ yadidaṃ kumārakassapo”ti (a. ni.1.209,217) etadagge ṭhapesīti.
